second.scope: Accept only count=sum=0 empty-vector histograms as permitted by the unchanged source validator; no audit/runtime rerun.

endpoint_stage_semantics: Separate root-owned validation; six existing envelopes per native cohort are hash-bound only.
method: Completed/successful calls and input keys per second use the complete cohort elapsed denominator. Per-operation rates use that same denominator. Means use total whole-call nanoseconds/count. Combined and pooled p50/p95/p99 merge original validated raw histogram buckets by call count; no percentile averaging or division of latency by key count. Inactive operation latency is null.

details.explanation: Root incorrectly required healthy single-attempt behavior across initialization in the ancillary freeze summary, although frozen protocol records it separately and preserves failures/extra attempts. Root then incorrectly launched the already reviewed diagnostic without checking the earlier tool exit. Preserve first recording and exact chronology; no rerun or source/predicate edit. Pre-existing driver/auditor preparation records establish their hashes before timing; the final root inventory is explicitly postlaunch.
